nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 token held in escrow by the FundingLocker; target of every outbound transfer.
Immutable address of the Loan contract; used as the access-control authority and as a transfer recipient.
Constructor that binds the immutable liquidityAsset and loan addresses.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == loan; sole access-control gate for pull and drain.
External isLoan-guarded function transferring an arbitrary amount of liquidity asset to an arbitrary destination.
External isLoan-guarded function sweeping the full liquidity asset balance to the loan address.
Caller-controlled address compared against the loan state variable inside the isLoan modifier.
External low-level call executing liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt) from pull; hands control to the token contract.
External low-level call executing liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(loan, amt) from drain after balanceOf; hands control to the token contract.
Destination address parameter of pull, fully attacker/Loan controlled.
Amount parameter of pull, fully attacker/Loan controlled.
Constructor parameter assigning the immutable liquidityAsset token address.
Constructor parameter assigning the immutable loan address.
Local variable in drain holding liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) before the transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside the isLoan modifier and compared with the loan state variable, forming the only access-control decision in the contract.
The loan state variable is the trusted counterpart used to validate msg.sender in the isLoan modifier.
The isLoan modifier gates entry into pull.
The isLoan modifier gates entry into drain.
Constructor writes the immutable liquidityAsset state variable.
Constructor writes the immutable loan state variable.
_liquidityAsset constructor parameter flows into the liquidityAsset state variable.
_loan constructor parameter flows into the loan state variable.
pull executes the safeTransfer unsafe operation.
The liquidityAsset token address is the callee of the external safeTransfer call in pull.
The dst parameter is passed directly as the recipient of safeTransfer in pull.
The amt parameter is passed directly as the value of safeTransfer in pull.
drain executes the safeTransfer unsafe operation.
The liquidityAsset token address is the callee of the external safeTransfer call in drain.
The loan state variable is used as the recipient of the swept balance in drain.
The local amt read from balanceOf is passed as the value of safeTransfer in drain.
The external token call in pull transfers control to attacker-controlled or malicious token code that can re-enter pull before state settles.
The external token call in drain transfers control to token code that can re-enter drain and repeat the balance-based sweep.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter dst has no independent semantics; it is only used as the recipient argument of the safeTransfer unsafe operation in pull.
Parameter amt has no independent semantics; it is only used as the value argument of the safeTransfer unsafe operation in pull.
Constructor parameter _liquidityAsset is used only to initialize the immutable liquidityAsset state variable inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter _loan is used only to initialize the immutable loan state variable inside the constructor.
Local variable amt is a transient balanceOf result consumed immediately by the safeTransfer unsafe operation in drain.
